shots.line: Under the northern lights, you found three artificial intelligence companies across Helsinki.
At Lapinlahdenkatu 16 stands Saidot, founded in 2018 by Meeri Haataja to build an AI governance platform.
On Lönnrotinkatu 32, Inven uses AI to assist private market professionals with deal sourcing and research.
At Kaisaniemenkatu 2 B, Sievo has turned purchasing data into procurement analytics since 2003.
Three companies, three distinct uses of data and artificial intelligence in the city.
